meta.title: RFQ bid: Quote only one of two products
gaps: Submit a vendor bid with a price entered for product 1 only while leaving product 2 unquoted.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Submit a vendor bid with a price entered for product 1 only while leaving product 2 unquoted.

steps.note: Start a new multi-stage event create flow.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding products.
Create the two products required by the scenario.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet for the created products.
Invite the vendor account that will test the portal bid.
Publish the RFQ so it is available in the vendor portal.
Verify that the RFQ reached a published project page.
Open the separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live RFQ's pricing round from the vendor event list.

args.need: in the vendor portal, enter a price for product 1 only, leave product 2 unquoted, submit the bid, and report whether Procol refuses it or allows the partial quote

steps.note: The catalog has no vendor-bid step that leaves one product unquoted.
Observe and record the resulting refusal or acceptance feedback after the partial-quote submission.
